BiblicalUsage: God calls the nations to bring forth their strong reasons, and the word means a bulwark or an argument, a defence set up like a wall. It appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God is not afraid of our arguments, because He invites the nations to bring their strongest case and watch it fall.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
